notes:
POC notes / conversation snippets:
- Customer: mid-market B2B productivity SaaS, multi-tenant product docs + in-app chat feature.
- Primary asks: predictable tail latency, token cost control, ability to isolate PII/enterprise customers to VPC.
- Workload mix observed during Hosted trial: ~70% chat (short turns), 25% doc search (embeddings + rerank), 5% long-form summarization.
- Traffic profile (observed): baseline 8--12 QPS, peak sustained 45--60 QPS during weekday daytime; short bursts to 120 QPS in synthetic tests. Concurrency typical 6--30 depending on bursts; 95th token length per request ~600 tokens (prompt+history), mean prompt 170 tokens; mean generated tokens ~210.
- Token mix: prompts heavy on contextual history (avg history length 3 turns), embedding calls for search are small (avg 512 tokens indexed snippets), reranker uses embeddings + cross-encoder for top 5.
- Latency targets: product wants <400ms P95 for chat median, <150ms for non-blocking features; willing to accept 700ms for long-form summarize.
- Cost sensitivity: mid but focused on unit economics; interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions (batching + KV prefix cache) to reduce token spend 20-35%.
- Security: require SSO (SAML), SOC2 compliance evidence, audit logging, KMS integration, and US data residency for enterprise customers.
- Dedicated ask: sizing for 2 environments (staging + prod), target sustained prod throughput 60 QPS with headroom for bursts to 150 QPS; 99th pct latency goal <800ms. Prefer VPC peering and private egress for customer data.
- SE recommendation summary (Priya): dedicated pool equivalent to 2 x A100-40GB (model mix: 1x full fp16 instance for high-quality chat + 1x quantized 4-bit pool for fallback/low-cost inference) or an alternative of 4 x A10 GPUs with autoscaling policies; set autoscale thresholds at 60% utilization, enable prefix/KV cache for repeat queries, enable continuous batching for embeddings.
- Customer quote: "We loved the onboarding speed of Hosted. Need the economics and isolation of Dedicated for enterprise deals."
- Risk notes: network peering timeline unknown (infra team busy), legal wants retention policy tightened for logs, procurement needs 3 vendor references before sign-off.
- Linked artifacts: pricing deck (drive:/Sales/Ceres/2026-03-Redwood-Pricing-Deck.pdf), security questionnaire (drive:/Security/Ceres/security-questionnaire-ceres-2026.xlsx), load test report attached to RDW-1124.
- Internal notes: recommend 1:1 AE+SE exec meeting with CTO to speed budget ask; prepare a 12-month cost model showing token mix impact and break-even vs Hosted-only.
- Short-form next steps (from AE): 1) deliver Dedicated sizing and cost worksheet by 2026-03-15; 2) schedule infra peering call (week of 2026-03-16); 3) provide SOC2 report + spare reference customer intro.
